responsibility: This header declares the Windows-specific helper functions used by libgccjit internals. It exposes print_last_error for Win32 diagnostic reporting and win_mkdtemp for secure temporary-directory creation, while pulling in the necessary Windows headers under WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN. It is the platform support interface paired with jit-w32.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Windows-specific support interface used by libgccjit internals, namely print_last_error and win_mkdtemp, and pulls in Windows headers. Unlike jit-w32.cc, it is only the declaration layer for those Win32 helpers, not their API-level implementation.
